strings.name: Alex Honnold
strings.summary: Alex Honnold is known for free soloing major walls. His first ropeless ascent of El Capitan’s Freerider in 2017 and its documentary brought climbing to wider audiences. He also completes technical alpine routes with partners. His foundation supports community solar projects, and in 2026 he climbed Taipei 101 without ropes.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His free solos of major rock walls expanded climbing’s public reach, and he advances environmental nonprofit projects.

strings.highlights.h1.title: El Capitan free solo
strings.highlights.h1.text: Made the first ropeless ascent of Freerider in 2017.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Public reach and energy access
strings.highlights.h2.text: Free Solo widened climbing’s visibility; his foundation supports community solar access.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Taipei 101 ascent
strings.timeline.t1.text: Completed the ropeless exterior climb on January 25 local time, broadcast worldwide.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Free Solo wins an Oscar
strings.timeline.t2.text: The film about his climb won documentary feature; the award went to the filmmaking team.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Freerider free solo
strings.timeline.t3.text: Completed the El Capitan route in Yosemite without ropes.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Shared Piolet d’Or
strings.timeline.t4.text: Honored with Tommy Caldwell for their 2014 Fitz Traverse.

strings.timeline.t5.text: Supported community-led solar and energy-access projects.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Half Dome free solo
strings.timeline.t6.text: Climbed the Regular Northwest Face without protection.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Two routes in a day
strings.timeline.t7.text: Free soloed Astroman and the Rostrum in a single day.
strings.timeline.t8.title: College and climbing
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered Berkeley, later leaving to focus on climbing.
